# routeros_routing_bgp_vpls (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the VPLS instance.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `bridge` (String) Name of the bridge the dynamically created pseudowire interfaces are added to as ports.
- `bridge_cost` (Number) The spanning tree path cost assigned to the dynamically created bridge ports.
- `bridge_horizon` (String) The split horizon group of the dynamically created bridge ports. Ports that share the same horizon value do not forward traffic to each other. The value is either `none` or a number.
- `bridge_pvid` (Number) The port VLAN id assigned to the dynamically created bridge ports.
- `cisco_id` (String) The VPLS identifier used for the interoperability with the Cisco style BGP signaled VPLS, written as `RouteDistinguisher:VPLSId`.
- `comment` (String)
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `export_route_targets` (Set of String) The route targets attached to the VPLS NLRI advertised by this instance.
- `import_route_targets` (Set of String) The route targets a received VPLS NLRI has to carry to be accepted into this instance.
- `interface_list` (String) Name of the interface list the dynamically created pseudowire interfaces are added to.
- `local_pref` (Number) The LOCAL_PREF attribute value of the VPLS NLRI advertised by this instance.
- `pw_control_word` (String) Whether the pseudowire control word is used. `default` follows the global MPLS settings.
- `pw_l2mtu` (Number) The layer2 MTU signaled for the pseudowires of this instance.
- `pw_type` (String) The pseudowire encapsulation type signaled for this instance.
- `rd` (String) The route distinguisher prepended to the VPLS NLRI advertised by this instance, written as `ASN:number` or `IP:number`.
- `site_id` (Number) The VPLS site identifier of this router inside the instance. It has to be unique among all the sites of the VPLS.
- `vrf` (String) The VRF table this resource operates on.

### Read-Only

- `current_peers` (String) The peers this VPLS instance currently has a signaled pseudowire with.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `inactive` (Boolean)
